description: March 4 birthday meaning: Pisces decan 2, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a March 4 birthday falls in Pisces, in the second decan, with Neptune as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Pisces is mutable and water.

sections.heading: Personality of a March 4 birthday
paragraphs: A practical Pisces? March 4 makes the case. The birthday number 4 stands for structure and effort, anchoring a mutable water sign at roughly thirteen degrees, in its Moon-coloured decan. Interpreters see someone who builds safe, orderly spaces for feeling: the friend with the tidy kitchen, the reliable routine and the always-open door.

By noon UTC on March 4, the Sun has normally reached roughly 13° of Pisces. That places the date in the Pisces decan that astrologers give to Moon, the second of three. The Moon, which rules Cancer, acts as sub-ruler for Pisces between 10 and 19 degrees, roughly the first ten days of March. This decan tends to turn the sign's compassion towards home, family and the people closest at hand. Early-March birthdays are often linked with nurturing, intuitive and emotionally receptive temperaments, with long memories and a deep need to feel safe. The lunar influence can make moods ebb and flow in quick cycles. When they look after their own emotional tides as carefully as they tend other people's, these Pisceans often become the steady harbour that others return to.

sections.heading: Numerology of the March 4 birthday
paragraphs: A 4th-of-the-month birthday gives a birthday number of 4, with no further reduction needed. In numerology the birth day acts as a supplementary number, describing practical talents that sit beside the Life Path. The 4 stands for the square: four walls, four seasons, a stable base. Anyone born on the 4th is often pictured as organised, trustworthy and good at turning plans into schedules. They tend to prefer a method that has been tested to one that merely sounds exciting. The growing edge for 4s is usually flexibility, letting the structure bend when circumstances genuinely change.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same March 4 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: March 4 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 4 is the 63rd day of the year (64th in a leap year). In most years Aries season is under way by March 21, 17 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 4 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. March 4 is also the birthday of Miriam Makeba (1932), Khaled Hosseini (1965) and François Fillon (1954).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 4?
faq.answer: March 4 is Pisces in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Pisces, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 4?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 4 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 4th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 4?
faq.answer: By March 4 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 4?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a March 4 birthday are Miriam Makeba (1932), Khaled Hosseini (1965) and François Fillon (1954). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
